hook.say: True or false? Five facts about Africa, three seconds each. The last one ruins a famous assumption!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: The Nile flows from south to north.
questions.fact: It flows north through Egypt and empties into the Mediterranean.
questions.sayAnswer: True! It flows north through Egypt and empties into the Mediterranean Sea.

questions.q: It has snowed in the Sahara Desert.
questions.fact: Snow fell on the dunes near Ain Sefra, Algeria, in 1979 and again in 2016.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Snow has dusted the dunes near Ain Sefra in Algeria more than once.

questions.q: The Cape of Good Hope is Africa's southernmost point.
questions.fact: That is Cape Agulhas, about 55 km farther south.
questions.sayAnswer: False! That is Cape Agulhas, about 55 kilometers farther south.

questions.q: Africa is the only continent in all four hemispheres.
questions.fact: Both the Equator and the prime meridian cross Africa.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Both the Equator and the prime meridian run right through Africa.

questions.q: Egypt has more pyramids than any other country.
questions.fact: Sudan has at least 230 pyramids. Egypt has about 120 to 140.
questions.sayAnswer: False! Sudan has more than 200 pyramids. Egypt has fewer than 150.
